title: Sable: Fragile Snow
description: Tiny datapack that adds Snow Layers and Powder Snow to Sable's fragile blocks tag.
body:
A small datapack that adds Snow Layers and Powder Snow to Sable's fragile blocks list. 

Ever wanted to see where your friends have been travelling through snowy biomes? Now you can! Their tyres will leave tracks through the snow, making it possible to track them down. Also makes falling through powder snow a little more dramatic.
